title: Shater admin dashboard: Arabic RTL analytics on a floating laptop over a dark rock plinth
whatItIs: A dark navy cover with a huge cropped orange-and-white Arabic headline, a laptop floating above a rough stone plinth showing an RTL admin dashboard with stat cards, a line chart and order tables, and the Shater logo top-right.
whatItMeans: Powerful and grounded; the stone plinth gives a data dashboard unexpected weight and drama.
techniques: Float a device above an unexpected material plinth.
Crop a bold headline at the frame edges.
Mirror dashboard layout for RTL reading.
